Remove the stream, water, detached pebbles, surrounding land and any paper background. Extend the clipped stone surfaces with matching original brushwork, do not leave any straight rectangular crop edges. Exactly one rock, no tree, no people, no scenery panel, no rectangular beige sheet, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Retain aged-paper texture ONLY inside the stone silhouette. Actual alpha outside rock.
